hooks.command: node -e "var fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');var f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH||'';if(!f.endsWith('main.js'))process.exit(0);try{var c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'),w=[],n=path.basename(path.dirname(f));if(/ctx\.shadowBlur[^;]+;[\s\S]{0,200}for\s*\(|for\s*\([^)]+\)[\s\S]{0,100}ctx\.shadowBlur/.test(c))w.push('\u26a0  shadowBlur dentro de un loop \u2014 mu\xe9velo fuera para no destruir el rendimiento.');if(/ctx\.fillText\(.*[\u1F300-\u1FFFF]/u.test(c))w.push('\u26a0  Emoji en ctx.fillText() \u2014 dibuja con formas canvas en su lugar.');if(/setInterval/.test(c)&&!/requestAnimationFrame/.test(c))w.push('\u26a0  setInterval como game loop \u2014 usa requestAnimationFrame.');var lines=c.split('\n'),inDraw=false;lines.forEach(function(l,i){if(/function\s+(draw|render|paint)\b/.test(l))inDraw=true;if(inDraw&&/\}/.test(l)&&l.trim()==='\x7d')inDraw=false;if(inDraw&&/Math\.random\(\)/.test(l))w.push('\u26a0  Math.random() en funci\xf3n de render (l\xednea '+(i+1)+') \u2014 pre-computa en spawn.');});if(!/GameAudio/.test(c))w.push('\u2139  GameAudio no encontrado \u2014 agrega sonidos con /games:add-sounds '+n);if(w.length){console.log('\n\ud83d\udd0d Games Plugin \u2014 Quality Check: '+n+'/main.js');w.forEach(function(x){console.log('   '+x);});console.log('');}}catch(e){}"
